def striptags(self, /) -> str:
    value = str(self)
    
    while (start := value.find("<!--")) != -1:
        if (end := value.find("-->", start)) == -1:
            break
        value = f"{value[:start]}{value[end + 3:]}"
    
    while (start := value.find("<")) != -1:
        if (end := value.find(">", start)) == -1:
            break
        value = f"{value[:start]}{value[end + 1:]}"
    
    value = " ".join(value.split())
    return self.__class__(value).unescape()
